title: Devlog: Tree Trunk Orc
author: alekblom
selftext: Created a new character with 3 animations in Gemini, Tripo 3D, and Blender, served in Three.js in the browser.

comments.author: alekblom
comments.body: I find myself having to do quite a bit of manual mesh editing and rigging and animation, but it's still faaast in comparison to creating the models from scratch! If you'd like to check out the game or join gdiscord for updates: [sciasy.com](http://sciasy.com) \-> [sciasy.com/discord](http://sciasy.com/discord) \- Thanks

comments.author: ninjasaid13
comments.body: does your game not have pathfinding when you click on an area? it's move by arrow keys?

replies.body: It’s wasd and virtual joystick movement

replies.body: I think it would awesome if it was pathfinding instead of a tedious arrow movement.
